prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design Sylph so every agent action, edit, browser step, and test is a frame on one persistent causal rail.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed 1600x1000 desktop web app, no device frame, no marketing page.
Structure: A persistent left rail approximately 250px groups Repositories and nested Workspaces and never moves. A large live browser frame dominates the upper-right field. One precise perforated causal rail crosses beneath it, connecting agent intent, file edits, browser actions, checks, and preview states in time. The current position is flagged. Deferred or abandoned branches hang below but remain reachable. A compact code/diff window attaches to the selected frame. Top chrome shows Sylph, repository, branch, search and live control state.
Content: Repository folkhero-web; Workspaces Checkout restoration, Fix OAuth callback, Upgrade billing webhook; active task Polish the onboarding flow; browser preview shows a tasteful SaaS onboarding screen; current frame Verify responsive form; file src/routes/onboarding.tsx; states Edited, Checked, Previewed; Browser checks 4/4; Agent controlling browser; actions Take control and Return to agent.
Style/medium: Contemporary developer tool fully committed to a film cutting bench grammar without becoming a movie app. True black work field, coarse but subtle orange grain, punched white windows, condensed grotesk labels, state conveyed by grease marks, tape flags and punched corners. Literal engineering labels.
Composition/framing: Persistent left navigation is unmistakable. Browser preview is the largest single surface. The rail is one causal spine, not decoration. Use frame windows and sharp seams, not rounded bento cards.
Lighting/mood: Focused editing bench, precise and serious.
Color palette: ink black #0A0A0A, grain orange #F25A1F, punched white #F5F3EE, spool gray #2E2E2E.
Materials/textures: restrained film grain, matte black field, punched white windows, orange tape flag.
Text (verbatim where shown): Sylph, Repositories, Workspaces, folkhero-web, Checkout restoration, Fix OAuth callback, Upgrade billing webhook, Polish the onboarding flow, Verify responsive form, src/routes/onboarding.tsx, Edited, Checked, Previewed, Browser checks 4/4, Agent controlling browser, Take control, Return to agent.
Constraints: Must read instantly as an agentic remote IDE with persistent left navigation, live browser, code diff, skills and testing. Dense but usable. Accessible contrast. No fake claims.
Avoid: cinema branding, movie thumbnails, timeline editor clone, control room metaphor, bento dashboard, generic VS Code clone, neon glow, glassmorphism, marketing page, device frame, tiny illegible text.
